data.exact_reserve_text: The result is driven by reserve increases in the closed years, where the 2013 and 2016 years have required reserve strengthening beyond their respective pure year close position. In contrast the 2014 and 2015 years are performing better than expected when those years were closed.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced mixed prior-year reserve movements at the 2019 year-end. Certain closed years (notably 2013 and 2016) required reserve strengthening driven by large claims and catastrophe exposures as well as liability and specialty loss ratio deterioration, while 2014 and 2015 showed favourable development relative to their closes. Named 2019 events (Dallas tornadoes and Storm Dorian) produced modest net losses. The overall effect was a combination of adverse development on specific older years and favourable development on others.

data.data_quality_notes: No single explicit GROSS prior-year reserve movement (total GBP m) for prior underwriting years was found in the 'movement in prior year's provision' note. Narrative and year-of-account commentary indicate mixed development: reserve strengthening for 2013 and 2016 and favourable development for 2014 and 2015. A gross claims development triangle is present and class-level gross movements for prior-period claims are reported (see 'significant movements' table), but the report does not present a single gross prior-year movement figure; therefore prior_year_development_gbp_m is left null. The lob_movements use the 'significant movements in gross claims incurred in respect of claims provisions created at the end of the previous period' table (explicit gross GBP 000 amounts).
